# myjfrog_regions (Data Source)

Provides a list of MyJFrog [regions](https://jfrog.com/help/r/jfrog-rest-apis/regions). This data source does not require authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "myjfrog_regions" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `regions` (Attributes List) List of regions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `cloud` (String) Cloud provider.
- `region_code` (String) Region code.
- `region_name` (String) Region name.
